opportunities.name: United.com flight search
opportunities.description: Search United flights from {origin} to {destination} with {trip type}, {dates}, {travelers}, {cabin} and optional award (miles) mode, then review or select fares.
steps: Open united.com Book > Flight tab
Pick Roundtrip or One-way; tick 'Book with miles' or 'Flexible dates' if needed
Type the origin in From and pick the airport suggestion
Type the destination in To and pick the airport suggestion
Open the date picker, move to the month you want, and click the departure (and return) dates
Open Travelers and set adults/children counts
Pick the cabin (Economy / Premium economy / Business)
Click Find flights
On results, adjust the date if needed and open the fare or details/seats for the flight you want

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor restaurant search with filter
opportunities.description: Find restaurants in {location} on Tripadvisor and apply a {cuisine/feature/dietary} filter, then optionally act on a result.
steps: Open tripadvisor.com and click Restaurants
Click the 'Where to?' search box and type the location
Pick the matching location suggestion
In the left filter panel, open 'Show more' under the right category (Cuisine, Dietary Restrictions, Restaurant features)
Check the filter you want and click Apply
Review results (optionally open a restaurant, Order online, or Save to a Trip)

Los Angeles, CA; Cuisine: Indian; opened Urban Masala, saved to new trip 'Los Angeles'
Big Sur, CA; Restaurant feature: Outdoor Seating

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search
opportunities.description: Find SpotHero parking near {venue} for {event/date}, set entry/exit times and filters such as wheelchair accessible, then pick a spot.
steps: Open spothero.com and type the venue in the search box
Pick the venue suggestion
In the events modal, optionally pick an event date, then click the event
Optionally open Filter, check options (e.g. Wheelchair Accessible) and click Show Results
Change the Enter After / Exit Before times and click Update Search
Click Book Now on the spot you want

opportunities.name: United Explore-destinations map search
opportunities.description: Use United's map search to see destination prices from {origin} for {trip type} with {date mode}.
steps: Open United map search (Book > Map search)
Type the origin in 'Flying from' and pick the airport suggestion
Set trip type (Roundtrip) and Dates (Flexible / Exact)
Click Search
Open 'List of search results' or browse the map
